scope: any suspected chemical, powder, or spray in or near the eye; an emergency routing intent, not a routine eye response
patterns: cleaning spray went into my eye
dishwasher detergent powder in my eye
child got shampoo or cleaner in an eye
a chemical splashed both of my eyes
fertilizer chemical got in my eye
response: Start rinsing the eye immediately with clean lukewarm running water, holding the eyelid open, and keep rinsing for at least 15 to 20 minutes. Do not delay to look up the product. If contact lenses come out during rinsing, let them go. Do not rub the eye, use eye drops, or put anything in the eye other than water or sterile saline unless emergency personnel tell you to. Once rinsing is underway, arrange emergency medical assessment and take the product container or name with you.
red_flags: vision change, severe pain, or a painful red eye
caustic substance such as drain or oven cleaner, cement, or an unknown strong chemical
both eyes affected or a large amount of substance
